mechanism: Fluphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of colchicine, increasing colchicine levels and toxicity risk; additive anticholinergic effects may also occur.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity signs (GI symptoms, myopathy, neuropathy); consider dose reduction of colchicine or use alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP3A4 inhibition.
